title: Who Has Been Discipling Me This Week?
headline: Who Is Discipling You This Week?
tagline: You become remarkably similar to the voices you repeatedly trust.
seo_title: Who Is Discipling You? A Weekly Audit (John 10:27) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Every week someone disciples you: news, social media, fear or Jesus. A short audit for men on the voices shaping them, from John 10:27.
verse_text: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.

scriptures.text: My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me.

items: The question isn’t whether you’re being influenced.
What voice shaped my emotions most?
What voice occupied my attention most?
Which voice sounded most like Jesus?
I ask questions before giving advice.

blocks.text: Would those closest to me describe me as interesting…. or interested?
You become remarkably similar to the voices you repeatedly trust.

items: They learn to recognize the Shepherd’s voice.
